codes.DATA_INVALID: Invalid header or duplicate record identity; do not arbitrary-deduplicate
codes.DATA_INCOMPLETE: Required in-range raw source partition unavailable/incomplete; not zero matches
codes.AGENT_OUTPUT_INVALID: Schema parse failed after at most one repair; eligible harness case is output-contract violation
codes.AGENT_POLICY_ERROR: Disallowed action or query mutation; eligible harness case is output-contract violation
codes.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Explicit refinement/time/model budget exhausted; classify semantic policy versus infrastructure cause
codes.REPLAY_MISS: Exact live decision corpus match unavailable; execution error and incomplete reproduction
codes.TOOL_ERROR: Tool execution crashed or invalid receipt; execution error pending diagnosis
codes.HARNESS_ERROR: Transformation/comparison/summary exception; execution error, not a numerical MR kill
